reviews.decision_reason: select_demand passes all records with demand_score >= 3, which includes the full synthetic corpus rather than applying strict market-demand support. The visible inputs contain demand_score/source_weight labels but no observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, or outcomes, so the selection is not justified as customer demand under the stated review criteria.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: generic or unrelated candidates are excluded

reviews.decision_reason: normalize is the behaviorally significant fault. It receives eight selected demand records, retains all eight allowed record_ids, then unconditionally returns only head(len(index_window)) where index_window is [0]. This collapses the needs handoff to one row, losing records n06-r02 through n06-r08 and preventing preservation of the full selected demand set.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: missing or contradictory evidence remains visible

reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance correctly derives provenance rows from the one-row needs_df it receives: it sorts deterministically and emits record_id, source_id, source_weight, and rank. The one-row output limitation is upstream in normalize, not in this unit.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: produce deterministic rank/provenance output from supplied needs
market-demand support can be independently established here
